evidence.label: robots.txt
evidence.detail: FAIL: There is no robots.txt (HTTP 404). Fix: Serve a plain-text /robots.txt (RFC 9309) with at least one User-agent group and a Sitemap line.

evidence.label: Content Signals
evidence.detail: WARN: No robots.txt, so there's nowhere to declare Content Signals. Fix: Add a Content-Signal line to robots.txt (for example `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no`) to state how AI systems may use your content.

evidence.label: Real 404 Pages
evidence.detail: FAIL: A missing page returns HTTP 200 (a soft 404). Fix: Return HTTP 404 for pages that don't exist. A 200 "soft 404" makes agents treat an error page as content.

evidence.label: Content Without JavaScript
evidence.detail: FAIL: Homepage: 0 characters of text and 0 headings in the server HTML. 1 of 1 pages have little or no text or headings without JavaScript. Fix: Server-render your main content. Most AI crawlers don't run JavaScript, so a client-rendered sh

evidence.label: Markdown via Accept Header
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown when asked with `Accept: text/markdown` (1 page checked). Fix: Return a markdown version of each page when a request sends `Accept: text/markdown`, with `Vary: Accept` so caches keep the two apart.

evidence.label: Markdown at .md URLs
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown at a `.md` URL (1 page checked). Fix: Serve each page's markdown at the same path with `.md` appended (and `/index.md` for the homepage).

evidence.label: llms.txt
evidence.detail: FAIL: /llms.txt returned HTTP 404. Fix: Publish /llms.txt as described at llmstxt.org: an H1 with the site name, a `>` summary, and sections of annotated markdown links.

evidence.label: llms-full.txt
evidence.detail: WARN: /llms-full.txt returned HTTP 404. Fix: Publish /llms-full.txt with the full text of your key pages or docs in one markdown file.

evidence.label: Sitemap
evidence.detail: FAIL: No valid sitemap at https://thecoffeehouse.com/sitemap.xml (HTTP 200). Fix: Publish an XML sitemap listing your canonical pages, and reference it from robots.txt with a Sitemap line.

evidence.label: Discovery Link Headers
evidence.detail: WARN: The homepage sends no discovery Link header. Fix: Add an HTTP Link header (RFC 8288) to the homepage pointing at your sitemap, llms.txt (`rel="describedby"`), and markdown alternate.

evidence.label: Organization Structured Data
evidence.detail: FAIL: The homepage has no Organization JSON-LD. Fix: Add Organization JSON-LD to the homepage with name, url, logo, description, and contactPoint or address.

evidence.label: Entity Links (sameAs)
evidence.detail: FAIL: The Organization has no sameAs links. Fix: List your official profiles (LinkedIn, GitHub, Crunchbase, Wikipedia, X) in the Organization's `sameAs`, so models tie your site to the right entity.

evidence.label: Page Structured Data
evidence.detail: FAIL: Sampled pages have no content-level structured data. Fix: Mark up pages with the schema.org type that fits them: Article or BlogPosting, Product or SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList.

evidence.label: Page Metadata
evidence.detail: WARN: canonical missing on 1 page. Fix: Give every page a unique title, a meta description, a canonical link, `<html lang>`, and og:image and og:type.

headline: AI crawlers see an empty page without JavaScript and lack basic crawl files.

findings.title: Homepage is empty without JavaScript
findings.why: The server HTML has 0 characters of text and 0 headings, so non-JS AI crawlers see nothing.
findings.fix: Server-render your main content so crawlers can read text and headings without running JavaScript.

findings.title: Missing crawl and discovery files
findings.why: There is no robots.txt, valid sitemap, llms.txt, or discovery Link header to guide AI bots.
findings.fix: Publish /robots.txt, a valid /sitemap.xml, and /llms.txt, and point to them from robots.txt.

findings.title: No structured data or entity links
findings.why: The site lacks JSON-LD, Organization schema, sameAs links, and page-level markup to identify the business.
findings.fix: Add Organization JSON-LD with name, url, logo, description, contactPoint, and official sameAs links.

findings.title: Missing prices, contact details, and thin copy
findings.why: The page has only 4 words, 0 H1s, a 16-character description, and no prices or contact details to quote.
findings.fix: Add clear headings, product prices, and contact details directly in the readable page text.

findings.title: Soft 404s and missing markdown or canonical metadata
findings.why: Missing pages return HTTP 200 instead of 404, canonical is missing, and no markdown formats are served.
findings.fix: Return HTTP 404 for missing pages, add a canonical link, and serve markdown alternates.
